vm_tools: concierge: Run crosvm commands synchronously Currently concierge spawns a process to run a crosvm command but doesn't wait for it to exit. This is a problem at suspend time because concierge will report suspend readiness to powerd and the crosvm command process will race with the system going to suspend. If the system suspends before all vcpus have been stopped the guest kernel will panic on resume because it thinks there is a soft lockup. Always wait for the crosvm command process to complete before continuing. BUG=chromium:946847 TEST=suspend and resume a device with a VM running. check the logs to see that the "Setting resolv config" message appears in the logs after crosvm logs that the run mode has changed to running. Change-Id: Iba91729e126319c59f030d932003ffff3bd8e549 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1541848 Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Tested-by: Chirantan Ekbote <chirantan@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Stephen Barber <smbarber@chromium.org>

vm_tools: concierge: Properly clean up child exits If crosvm exits on its own (for example, due to a guest kernel panic) then concierge doesn't delete the TerminaVm pointer correspending to that VM from the `termina_vms_` field in the Service class. This is a problem because the pointer is now pointing to freed memory and will cause a segfault if we try to dereference it later. Make sure to delete the TerminaVm pointer and also notify cicerone that the VM was stopped.
